scope: Lesson 36 only; bounded health, cognitive, methodological, and adverse-event claims
non_claims: No source validates kamma, rebirth, 31 realms, Nibbāna, Abhidhamma mind moments, or Buddhist cosmology.

Conceptual resonance is not empirical confirmation.
